source: Written for this project. Covers the tables this server's tools read plus every table a free key reads in full. Names, descriptions and notes are the project's own words; access levels are what the project observed with a free API key; filters, primary keys and refresh times come from the documented Tables API metadata endpoint.
license: MIT, like the rest of this project.

tables.name: ICE futures contract list
tables.description: One row per ICE futures contract: code, contract name, exchange, clearing code and expiry.

tables.name: ICE options-on-futures contract list
tables.description: One row per ICE option on a future: code, underlying future, exchange, clearing code and expiry.

tables.name: Futures commodity codes (Barchart)
tables.description: Barchart commodity codes for futures with their names, exchanges and processing type.
tables.notes: Not refreshed since mid-2023.

tables.name: Security type codes (EDI)
tables.description: Lookup of EDI security type codes and their names.

tables.name: Company balance sheets (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Balance sheet items per US company and reporting period: assets, liabilities, equity, cash and debt.

tables.name: Corporate actions (Nasdaq)
tables.description: One row per corporate event and symbol (split, dividend, merger, spin-off, symbol change) with value and counterparty.

tables.name: Company cash flow statements (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Cash flow items per US company and period: operating, investing and financing flows, capex, free cash flow.

tables.name: Carbon removal certificate transactions
tables.description: Carbon removal certificate bundle transactions per facility: date, methodology, transaction type, receiver, volume.

tables.name: Carbon removal facilities
tables.description: Registry of carbon removal facilities: location, methodology, durability category, owner and auditor.

tables.name: Company fundamentals, detailed (Nasdaq)
tables.description: One wide row per company, period and dimension that merges items from the NDAQ/BS, NDAQ/IS and NDAQ/CF tables.

tables.name: Carbon removal volumes by facility and year
tables.description: Carbon removal certificates issued (gross and net) and retired per facility and vintage year.

tables.name: Company fundamentals summary (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Headline figures per US company and period: valuation multiples, margins, returns on assets and equity.

tables.name: Carbon removal volumes by methodology and year
tables.description: Carbon removal certificates issued and retired per methodology and year, with shares by world region.

tables.name: Company income statements (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Income statement items per US company and period: revenue, costs, operating income, net income, EPS.

tables.name: Company reference data (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Company profile per symbol: name, exchange, sector, industry, identifiers and listing status.

tables.name: Carbon removal certificate retirements
tables.description: Individual certificate retirements: date, facility, beneficiary, country of retirement, volume and purpose.

tables.name: Retail trading activity, all tickers (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Daily retail share of trading (0-1) and net retail sentiment for the full universe of US tickers.
tables.notes: a few large stocks and ETFs on one day in 2016; recent dates return no rows.

tables.name: Retail trading activity, daily top 10 (Nasdaq)
tables.description: The ten US tickers most traded by retail investors each day, with retail share (0-1) and net sentiment.
tables.notes: Updated every trading day; history starts in late 2017.

tables.name: Company key statistics (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Latest snapshot per symbol: market value, 52-week high and low, 1- and 3-month average volume, EPS, P/E, P/B.

tables.name: Carbon removal certificate bundles
tables.description: Daily view of certificate bundles from issuance to retirement: facility, methodology, transaction type, holder.

tables.name: US ticker changes (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Dated pairs of US ticker symbol and FIGI, recording symbol changes and new listings.

tables.name: Mutual fund profiles (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Per fund: family, advisers, objective, strategy, risks, turnover and net assets.
tables.notes: about 30 funds.

tables.name: Mutual fund master list (Nasdaq)
tables.description: One row per US registered fund: fund id, name, investment company type, LEI, SEC series id and CIK.
tables.notes: about 30 open-end funds, current.

tables.name: Mutual fund monthly flows (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Per fund and month: money in from sales and reinvestment, money out through redemptions.

tables.name: Share class monthly returns (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Monthly returns per fund share class.

tables.name: Fund risk and return analytics (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Per share class against a benchmark over 3, 5 and 10 years: alpha, beta, Sharpe, capture ratios, drawdown.
tables.notes: about 90 share classes, mostly not those in the share class master sample.

tables.name: Fund benchmark list (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Benchmark ids with name, index family and flags (blended, hedged, net, after tax) used by the return tables.
tables.notes: a few dozen benchmarks.

tables.name: Fund portfolio holdings (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Every reported holding per fund and date from SEC N-PORT filings; the ticker filter is the holding's ticker.
tables.notes: no rows.

tables.name: Fund top 10 holdings (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Ten largest holdings per fund and date from SEC N-PORT filings: issuer, identifiers, value and weight.
tables.notes: about 30 funds, recent filing dates.

tables.name: Fund portfolio managers (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Portfolio managers per fund: name, role, ownership, biography and years of experience.
tables.notes: several hundred funds, mostly outside the fund master sample.

tables.name: Share class prices and returns (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Latest price and trailing returns from 1 day to 10 years per share class, with 52-week range and yield.

tables.name: Share class fees and expenses (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Per share class: expense ratios, management and 12b-1 fees, waivers, sales and redemption charges.

tables.name: Share class master list (Nasdaq)
tables.description: Share classes with fund id, name, CUSIP, FIGIs and symbols; the trading symbol is usually in nav_symbol.
tables.notes: about 100 share classes from about 30 funds.

tables.name: Bitcoin network metrics
tables.description: Daily Bitcoin series by code: price, market cap, hash rate, difficulty, transaction counts, supply and more.
tables.notes: Not updated since June 2026; some days are missing.

tables.name: Crypto exchange rates (Bitfinex)
tables.description: Daily high, low, mid, last, bid, ask and volume per Bitfinex currency pair code.
tables.notes: Not updated since June 2026; most altcoin pairs stop in early 2024.

tables.name: CFTC index trader supplement
tables.description: Weekly CFTC report for agricultural futures with the positions of commodity index traders, by market and type.
tables.notes: No new weekly reports since June 2026.

tables.name: CFTC concentration ratios
tables.description: Weekly share of open interest held by the 4 and 8 largest traders, gross and net, per futures market.
tables.notes: No new weekly reports since June 2026.

tables.name: CFTC disaggregated commitments of traders
tables.description: Weekly positions of producers, swap dealers, money managers and other traders per futures market and type.
tables.notes: No new weekly reports since June 2026.

tables.name: Oil and gas statistics by country (JODI)
tables.description: Monthly oil and gas production, demand, stocks and trade per country and product-flow-unit code.
tables.notes: Data ends in late 2024; values are stored as text.

tables.name: CFTC legacy commitments of traders
tables.description: Weekly commercial, non-commercial and non-reportable positions per futures market and report type.
tables.notes: No new weekly reports since June 2026.

tables.name: Metal warehouse stocks (LME)
tables.description: Daily metal stock movements in tonnes per metal and warehouse location: opening, in, out, closing.
tables.notes: Ends in July 2024; stock levels only, no prices.

tables.name: Corporate bond index yields
tables.description: Daily yields, spreads and total-return index levels per bond index series code.
tables.notes: Ends in February 2025. Total-return series are index levels; yield and spread series are percent.

tables.name: IMF country macro series
tables.description: Annual IMF World Economic Outlook figures per country and concept (GDP, inflation, debt...), with projections.
tables.notes: Frozen at the April 2023 edition; projections run to 2028.

tables.name: OPEC crude basket price
tables.description: Daily OPEC basket crude oil price in US dollars per barrel.
tables.notes: Ends in January 2024.

tables.name: Ticker list (QuoteMedia)
tables.description: Ticker symbols with exchange and company name.
tables.notes: Not updated since May 2025.

tables.name: Corporate actions (Sharadar)
tables.description: Dated corporate actions per US ticker: dividends, splits, symbol changes, delistings, acquisitions, spin-offs.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, full and current history.

tables.name: Daily valuation ratios (Sharadar)
tables.description: Daily enterprise value, market cap and P/E, P/B, P/S and EV multiples per US ticker.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, late 2018 only.

tables.name: Company filing events (Sharadar)
tables.description: SEC 8-K event codes per US ticker and date, pipe-separated; SHARADAR/INDICATORS explains the codes.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, full and current history.

tables.name: Column dictionary (Sharadar)
tables.description: Definitions of every column of the Sharadar tables, plus their event and action code lists.

tables.name: US stock prices (Sharadar)
tables.description: Daily open, high, low, close and volume per US stock, split-adjusted, with adjusted and raw closes.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, late 2018 only.

tables.name: US company fundamentals (Sharadar)
tables.description: About 100 fundamentals and ratios per US company, as first reported or restated, quarterly, annual or trailing.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, annual figures for 2022 and 2023.

tables.name: US insider transactions (Sharadar)
tables.description: Form 3, 4 and 5 insider filings per US ticker: owner, role, transaction code, shares, price and value.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, filings from late 2018.

tables.name: Institutional holdings (Sharadar)
tables.description: Quarterly 13F positions per institutional investor and US ticker: value and units by security type.

tables.name: Institutional ownership by ticker (Sharadar)
tables.description: Quarterly 13F totals per US ticker: holder counts, units and value by security type.

tables.name: Institutional portfolios by investor (Sharadar)
tables.description: Quarterly 13F totals per institutional investor: holding counts, units and value by security type.

tables.name: US fund prices (Sharadar)
tables.description: Daily open, high, low, close and volume for US ETFs, closed-end funds and ETNs.
tables.notes: about 25 funds, late 2018 only.

tables.name: S&P 500 membership history (Sharadar)
tables.description: Dated additions to and removals from the S&P 500 per ticker, plus current and historical member rows.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, with current membership and full history.

tables.name: US ticker master (Sharadar)
tables.description: One row per ticker per Sharadar table: name, exchange, sector, industry, identifiers, price and filing dates.
tables.notes: Full universe, current. exchange and sector are columns, not filters.

tables.name: USDA supply and demand estimates
tables.description: Values of the USDA WASDE report tables by report month: region, commodity, item, marketing year, period.
tables.notes: Last report: February 2024.

tables.name: USDA WASDE report tables
tables.description: Code, title, units and footnotes of each WASDE report table, per report month.
tables.notes: Last report: February 2024.

tables.name: World Bank development indicators
tables.description: Annual World Bank indicator values per series and economy; only series_id and country_code are filterable.
tables.notes: Years 1960 to 2023.

tables.name: World Bank indicator list
tables.description: Each World Bank series code used in WB/DATA with its name and definition.

tables.name: US stock prices, community data (WIKI)
tables.description: Daily open, high, low, close, volume and adjusted values per US ticker from a retired community dataset.
tables.notes: Frozen since March 2018; about 3,000 tickers.

tables.name: Analyst recommendation counts (Zacks)
tables.description: Current counts of strong buy, buy, hold and sell ratings per ticker, and the counts 1 to 3 months ago.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, current.

tables.name: Expected earnings dates (Zacks)
tables.description: Next expected report dates per ticker and the consensus for the coming quarter and year.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, current.

tables.name: Consensus EPS estimates (Zacks)
tables.description: Mean, median, high, low and count of EPS estimates per ticker and fiscal quarter or year.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, current estimates.

tables.name: EPS estimate revisions (Zacks)
tables.description: Consensus EPS now and 7, 30, 60 and 90 days ago, with counts of upward and downward revisions.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, current.

tables.name: Earnings surprises (Zacks)
tables.description: Reported EPS against the consensus per ticker and quarter, with the surprise in amount and percent.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, quarters of 2018.

tables.name: Long-term growth estimates (Zacks)
tables.description: Consensus long-term EPS growth rate and forward 12-month EPS estimates per ticker.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, current.

tables.name: Analyst rating history (Zacks)
tables.description: Daily counts of buy, hold and sell ratings and the mean recommendation per ticker.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, 2018 only.

tables.name: Consensus sales estimates (Zacks)
tables.description: Mean, median, high, low and count of revenue estimates per ticker and fiscal period.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, current estimates.

tables.name: Sales surprises (Zacks)
tables.description: Reported revenue against the consensus per ticker and fiscal period, in amount and percent.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, periods of 2018.

tables.name: Analyst price targets (Zacks)
tables.description: Daily mean, median, high and low analyst price targets per ticker, with revision counts.
tables.notes: about 30 large US stocks, 2018 only.

tables.name: Zillow housing series
tables.description: Monthly home value, rent, inventory and sales figures per Zillow indicator id and region id.
tables.notes: Home values end in mid-2025 (early 2025 for metros and ZIPs), rents in mid-2022; inventory and sales cover metros only.

tables.name: Zillow indicator list
tables.description: Zillow indicator ids with their names and categories.

tables.name: Zillow region list
tables.description: Zillow region ids with type (ZIP, city, county, metro, state, neighborhood) and name.
tables.notes: The region filter matches the full stored name only.
